summary: A humorous, mock-epic account of Jamie Hollister's first months as a new city-dweller in the fictional Somewheresville, from September 15 to December 2, 2023. It follows Jamie through navigation mishaps, quirky locals, household and internet troubles, odd food, a bus mix-up, festivals, and finally acceptance into the community at a chili cook-off.
one_line: Jamie Hollister's comic first months in the fictional city of Somewheresville, from getting lost and meeting eccentric locals to joining the community.
key_facts: Jamie Hollister moved from a sleepy suburban hamlet known for aggressive squirrels and disappearing garden gnomes to Somewheresville on September 15, 2023.
On September 20, Jamie discovered three dead ends, two unnamed alleys, and a pizzeria claiming to serve "the best slice in the universe."
Gary "The Pigeon Whisperer" Mervin is an elderly local who gives unsolicited advice and distributes breadcrumbs.
On September 25, Jamie was befriended by Patricia "Patty" McSnack, owner of an exotic tea and scone shop that gives a free scone with every cuppa.
On October 3, Jamie battled a clap-on, clap-off light fixture until neighbor Ted "Two Left Feet" Thompson knocked on the door.
On October 10, Jamie spun a wheel at a 'mystery menu' diner and got "Surprise Stew," whose ingredients are still debated.
On October 17, Jamie took a bus in the wrong direction and ended up at the end-of-line stop "Nowhere in Particular."
The "Funky Fungus Fest" on October 25 celebrated mushroom growers, and Jamie danced the Mushroom Mambo.
The Quirky Kite Carnival on November 1 featured a colossal kite shaped like Gary's pigeons.
On November 5, Jamie did "The Weekly Shop" at Megalo-Mart and reached the forgotten parking area Lot E.
The internet installation began November 12 and took four attempts, with Alex "The Router Reanimator" Ramirez finally solving it.
The annual Ice Skating Rink opened November 20, and Jamie struggled on the ice while small children glided gracefully.
On December 2, Jamie helped judge the Great Chili Cook-Off, cementing membership in the community.
